title: John Lennon watches Neil Young perform in Los Angeles | 1973
content:
John Lennon and May Pang watched Neil Young perform at the Roxy Theatre in Los Angeles, USA, on 22 September 1973.

Located on the Sunset Strip in West Hollywood, the Roxy had opened a few days earlier on 20 September. Neil Young and the Santa Monica Flyers played at the venue for the first three days it was open, with support from Grin.

Lennon and Pang watched Richie Havens plays at the Roxy two days later.
